parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity standard type, relation, value, units, comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, then to activities on record_id, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
